name: cavemio-attachment-chip
title: Attachment chip
description: A file on its way into a prompt: uploading, being read, ready or failed.

cavemio.usage:
import { AttachmentChip } from "@/components/attachment-chip";

<AttachmentChip name="q3-sales.pdf" type="application/pdf" size={2_400_000} status="uploading" progress={0.42} onRemove={remove} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- Each step is announced politely ("Uploading q3-sales.pdf", "q3-sales.pdf is ready"), but never every percent.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, states change in place.
- The remove button is labelled with the file name, e.g. "Remove q3-sales.pdf".
- Long names truncate; the chip never grows past 260px.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: name / size / type
props.description: – · File name, size in bytes and MIME type (picks the icon).

props.name: error / onRetry
props.description: – · Why it failed, and a Retry link.

useCases.title: AI prompt boxes
useCases.description: Show a file the person dropped into the prompt while it uploads and is read.

useCases.title: Email and message composers
useCases.description: Attachments on a message that is still being written.

useCases.title: Forms with uploads
useCases.description: Documents for job applications, claims and verification.

useCases.title: Knowledge bases
useCases.description: Files added for an assistant or a search index to read.

features.title: Upload progress
features.description: A ring fills round the icon while “Uploading 42%” rolls with it.

features.title: A step for being read
features.description: When the upload is done the line morphs to “Reading” under a sweep of light.

features.title: Ready at a glance
features.description: The line settles into the type and size, such as “PDF · 2.4 MB”.

features.title: Thumbnails for images
features.description: Pass a preview URL and the image shows, brightening to full when ready.

features.title: Failures say why
features.description: The icon becomes an alert, the line shows the reason and Retry opens in beside it.

features.title: Easy to remove, easy to hear
features.description: A remove button named after the file, and each step announced politely, never every percent.

states.title: uploading
states.description: A progress ring fills around the icon and "Uploading 42%" rolls with it.

states.title: processing
states.description: The ring fades (360ms), the percent folds away and the line morphs to "Reading" under a 1.4s sweep of light.

states.title: ready
states.description: The line morphs into type and size, e.g. "PDF · 2.4 MB"; a thumbnail brightens to full.

states.title: error
states.description: A red border, the icon blurs into an alert, the line morphs to the reason and Retry opens in.
